name: Androgen receptor signalling
author: Jude Gomila
message: Editing pass: every TL;DR and summary stands alone

fields.before: "Prostate cancer's engine. Testosterone becomes DHT, binds the androgen receptor, and drives growth genes. Castration removes the fuel; newer pills block the receptor or the enzyme that makes fuel inside the tumour."
